description: Bihar-based startup Sarva Suvidhaen is using AI and IoT to modernise Indian Railways, improve operational efficiency, and build smarter railway systems ...
body_lead: India’s railway network is one of the largest and most complex public infrastructure systems in the world. Every day, thousands of trains, millions of passengers, freight transportation, stations, tracks, and field teams operate simultaneously. In such a system, even a small delay can have an impact across multiple levels. Sometimes, reports from the field do not arrive on time. In some cases, data remains scattered across different systems. At times, officials are unable to obtain real-time information about a situation.
